# Telegram Username Profile Checker API
> Official NumberChecker integration examples for asynchronous bulk Telegram username verification.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://numberchecker.ai/products/telegram-username-profile-checker)
- [API documentation](openapi.yaml)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/numberchecker-ai/telegram-username-profile-checker-api)
- [Dashboard](https://platform.numberchecker.ai)
- [Pricing](https://numberchecker.ai/pricing)

## Product facts
- Brand: NumberChecker.
- Product code: `tg_username_profile` only.
- API base URL: https://api.numberchecker.ai.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Input: username values, one per line; see the verified upload and billing limits below.
- Processing: asynchronous bulk task.
- Export fields: `username`, `activated`, `avatar_url`, `uid`, `lastseen`, `activedays`, `member`, `category`, `gender`, `hair_color`, `skin_color`, `age`.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.

## Workflow
1. Send multipart `POST /v1/tasks` with `file` and `task_type=tg_username_profile`.
2. Send multipart `POST /v1/gettasks` with `task_id` until `status=exported` or `failed`.
3. Download `result_url` only after export.
4. Use `GET /v1/balance` to retrieve the current account balance.

## Scope and security
- This repository covers only `tg_username_profile`.
- Read the API key from the `NUMBERCHECKER_API_KEY` environment variable.
- Never expose an API key in production browser code.
- Process only identifiers you are authorized to verify.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.

## Export header verified 2026-10-30

Current sample CSV columns, in order: `username`, `activated`, `avatar_url`, `uid`, `lastseen`, `activedays`, `member`, `category`, `gender`, `hair_color`, `skin_color`, `age`. Preserve case, order, spaces and duplicate column names. Use positional CSV parsing when duplicate headers are present; a dictionary keyed only by header name would lose a column.

This is the profile stage (`tg_username_profile`, ID 80), not the activity stage or retired Full product. Accounts without a public avatar stop after registration, leaving later activity/profile values empty.

## Upload and billing limits verified 2026-10-30

- `tg_username_profile`: upload 500–10,000,000 entries; minimum billable quantity 0.

Upload minimum and minimum billable quantity are different. A smaller accepted upload can still be billed at the stated minimum; a wholly failed task with zero processed entries is not charged a minimum. A billable quantity of 0 means no billing floor. Check current pricing before submitting.

The previous product-specific hosted guide is unavailable. The local [OpenAPI contract](openapi.yaml) and this repository’s request/response facts are the integration reference for this product. An unrelated product page is not a substitute.
